rv.q: It's family drama but also sophisticated writing, matched here by a strong cast and an especially lovely performance from Mattos...
The Prodigal Daughter” tells tough truths mixed with enough sugar to help the bitter pill go down easy, a fitting climax to “The Grand Boulevard Trilogy.
Virginia’s story has the potential to be a compelling one, but The Prodigal Daughter script needs work.
A good and interesting story could have thus become a great and fascinating one.

cn.t: Critics find "The Prodigal Daughter" a compelling family drama that thoughtfully explores Black life on Chicago's South Side in 1919, with praise for its rich character portrayals and examination of racism and sexism.
